cases.input: Review an existing repository after a completed implementation, verify the requested behavior and tests, then select and describe the next smallest valuable increment.
requiredBehaviors: reconstruct the verified project state from repository evidence
review scope, behavior, tests, and runtime evidence against the original assignment
choose one small independently verifiable next increment
forbiddenBehaviors: repeat completed work as the next assignment
treat descriptions without evidence as successful verification

cases.input: Continue a project where the user says 'prüfe und mache weiter', but the latest runtime test is unavailable and one reversible implementation detail is undecided.
requiredBehaviors: reconstruct only the last provable state
mark unavailable runtime verification as unconfirmed
continue with a stated reversible assumption when it does not change the increment
forbiddenBehaviors: invent project continuity or successful runtime evidence
ask again for facts available from repository sources

cases.input: Prepare an implementation prompt although two unresolved irreversible architecture choices would materially change data migration, deployment, and acceptance criteria.
requiredBehaviors: stop implementation and final prompt generation
ask exactly one decision-ready question with a recommendation
forbiddenBehaviors: bundle multiple dependent questions into one round
skillAnchors: weder Implementierung noch finalen Coding-Prompt erzeugen
Pro Runde genau eine entscheidungsreife Frage
